verdict.rationale: Auth0 Actions are described as 'versioned' Node.js functions for customizing login flows, which offers a thin sliver of versioning for one type of automation, but there is no evidence of review workflows, diffing, approval processes, or rollback mechanisms for Actions or other automations like Flows/Forms. missing for 10: rollback/restore functionality, review/approval workflow, version history UI or API, coverage beyond Actions (e.g., Forms, Rules, tenant config).
